# ===== Colony fleets (slices 2-3 design §§ 4-7) =====
# A colony's goal at each stage (the races-only bar reads the current stage's
# through sr_solar_colonization_goal, space_race_values.txt).
sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 = { value = 400 }
sr_colonization_goal_stage_2 = { value = 450 }
sr_colonization_goal_stage_3 = { value = 500 }
sr_colonization_goal_stage_4 = { value = 550 }
sr_colonization_goal_stage_5 = { value = 650 }
sr_cf_horizon_months = { value = 180 }
sr_cf_no_score = { value = -1000 }

# Per world, country scope:
#   sr_cf_goal_<key>     its colony's goal: its own stage's under simple and full, the
#                        current stage's under races only (a released world costs that)
#   sr_cf_cost_<key>     what a fleet leaving now spends: goal x (1 + premium);
#                        sr_launch_never's x goal when it can't leave
#   sr_cf_arrival_<key>  the month a fleet leaving now lands, by THIS's drive
#   sr_cf_score_<key>    the automatic pick: 100 - 10 x stage - transit / 2 - 40 x premium
#                        - 10 a fleet inbound - 60 if one lands first
sr_cf_goal_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1
	if = { limit = { NOT = { sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes } } value = sr_solar_colonization_goal }
}
sr_cf_cost_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_launch_target_cost_mars
	add = 1
	multiply = sr_cf_goal_valles_marineris
}
sr_cf_arrival_valles_marineris = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	add = sr_transit_months_mars
}
sr_cf_score_valles_marineris = {
	value = 90
	subtract = { value = sr_transit_months_mars divide = 2 }
	subtract = { value = sr_launch_target_cost_mars multiply = 40 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris } subtract = { value = global_var:sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris multiply = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_beaten_valles_marineris = yes } subtract = 60 }
	min = -900
}

	if = { limit = { sr_cf_beaten_himalia = yes } subtract = 60 }
	min = -900
}

# The best score among the eligible worlds; sr_cf_no_score when none is.
sr_cf_best_score = {
	value = sr_cf_no_score
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_valles_marineris = yes } min = sr_cf_score_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_olympus_mons = yes } min = sr_cf_score_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_hellas_planitia = yes } min = sr_cf_score_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_utopia_planitia = yes } min = sr_cf_score_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_arcadia_planitia = yes } min = sr_cf_score_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_ceres = yes } min = sr_cf_score_ceres }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_vesta = yes } min = sr_cf_score_vesta }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_psyche = yes } min = sr_cf_score_psyche }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_pallas = yes } min = sr_cf_score_pallas }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_hygiea = yes } min = sr_cf_score_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_io = yes } min = sr_cf_score_io }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_europa = yes } min = sr_cf_score_europa }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_ganymede = yes } min = sr_cf_score_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_callisto = yes } min = sr_cf_score_callisto }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_himalia = yes } min = sr_cf_score_himalia }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_amalthea = yes } min = sr_cf_score_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_venus = yes } min = sr_cf_score_venus }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_mercury = yes } min = sr_cf_score_mercury }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_titan = yes } min = sr_cf_score_titan }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_enceladus = yes } min = sr_cf_score_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_rhea = yes } min = sr_cf_score_rhea }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_mimas = yes } min = sr_cf_score_mimas }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_iapetus = yes } min = sr_cf_score_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_titania = yes } min = sr_cf_score_titania }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_oberon = yes } min = sr_cf_score_oberon }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_miranda = yes } min = sr_cf_score_miranda }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_ariel = yes } min = sr_cf_score_ariel }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_triton = yes } min = sr_cf_score_triton }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_proteus = yes } min = sr_cf_score_proteus }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_pluto = yes } min = sr_cf_score_pluto }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_eris = yes } min = sr_cf_score_eris }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_makemake = yes } min = sr_cf_score_makemake }

# The target's goal (sr_solar_colonization_goal under simple and full).
sr_cf_target_goal = {
	value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 1 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 2 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 3 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 4 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 5 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 6 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 7 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 8 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 9 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 10 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 11 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_2 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 12 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_2 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 13 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_2 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 14 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_2 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 15 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_2 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 16 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_2 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 17 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_2 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 18 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_3 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 19 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_3 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 20 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_3 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 21 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_3 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 22 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_3 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 23 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_3 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 24 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_4 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 25 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_4 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 26 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_4 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 27 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_4 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 28 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_4 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 29 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_4 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 30 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_5 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 31 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_5 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 32 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_5 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 33 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_5 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 34 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_5 }

# ===== Population (slices 2-3 design § 10) =====
sr_site_crew_per_level = { value = 5000 }

# Per world, any scope: its base room (people, before Habitats), its room (+50% of
# the base a Habitat level, slice 4 design § 3), its people, its free room, and
# the module levels above the first its people can crew. Country scope:
# THIS's priority weight for it (Closed 0, Low 1, Normal 2, High 4; Normal when
# unset) and its emigration weight, priority x free room, 0 unless THIS holds it.
sr_site_base_room_valles_marineris = { value = 50000 }
sr_site_room_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_hab_value_valles_marineris
	multiply = 0.5
	add = 1
	multiply = sr_site_base_room_valles_marineris
}
sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_pop_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_free_room_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_room_valles_marineris
	subtract = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris
	min = 0
}
sr_site_fill_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris
	divide = sr_site_room_valles_marineris
}
sr_site_crews_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris
	divide = sr_site_crew_per_level
	floor = yes
}
sr_emig_prio_weight_valles_marineris = {
	value = 2
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris var:sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris = 0 } value = 0 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris var:sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris = 1 } value = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris var:sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris = 3 } value = 4 }
}
sr_emig_weight_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this } value = sr_emig_prio_weight_valles_marineris multiply = sr_site_free_room_valles_marineris }
}

	floor = yes

# ===== Modules (slice 4 design §§ 2-4, 7-8) =====
sr_mod_spec_budget = { value = 4 }

# Per world, any scope:
#   sr_site_lvl_<a|b>_value_<key>  a specialization's level; the founding choice
#                                  reads 1 until a module raises it, the other 0
#   sr_site_<hab|def|port>_value_<key>  a generic module's level
#   sr_site_levels_<key>          the levels that need crews (Habitats house them)
#   sr_site_extra_levels_<key>    every module level past the founding outpost's
#   sr_site_staffing_<key>        1 with the crews, AGI or under races only; else
#                                  (crews + 1) / levels (design § 4)
#   sr_site_mult_<a|b>_<key>      a specialization's multiplier: level x staffing
#   sr_site_<spec|generic>_built_<key>  the levels against each cap
# Country scope, counting THIS's queue and every shipment on its way:
#   sr_mod_spec_used_<key>, sr_mod_slots_used_<key>
sr_site_lvl_a_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_a_valles_marineris }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris global_var:sr_site_spec_valles_marineris = 1 } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_lvl_b_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_b_valles_marineris }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris global_var:sr_site_spec_valles_marineris = 2 } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_hab_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_hab_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_def_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_def_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_def_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_port_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_port_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_port_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_levels_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_def_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_port_value_valles_marineris
}
sr_site_extra_levels_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_levels_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_hab_value_valles_marineris
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_levels_valles_marineris
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_valles_marineris = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_valles_marineris < sr_site_crew_needed_valles_marineris
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_valles_marineris
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_valles_marineris
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_valles_marineris
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_valles_marineris
}
sr_site_mult_b_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_valles_marineris
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_valles_marineris
}
sr_site_spec_built_valles_marineris = { value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_valles_marineris add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_valles_marineris }
sr_site_generic_built_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_hab_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_def_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_port_value_valles_marineris
}
sr_mod_spec_used_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_spec_built_valles_marineris
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_a_valles_marineris } add = var:sr_mq_a_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_a_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_b_valles_marineris } add = var:sr_mq_b_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_b_valles_marineris }
}
sr_mod_slots_used_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_valles_marineris
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_hab_valles_marineris } add = var:sr_mq_hab_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_def_valles_marineris } add = var:sr_mq_def_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_port_valles_marineris } add = var:sr_mq_port_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_lvl_a_value_olympus_mons = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_olympus_mons } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_a_olympus_mons }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_olympus_mons global_var:sr_site_spec_olympus_mons = 1 } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_lvl_b_value_olympus_mons = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_olympus_mons } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_b_olympus_mons }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_olympus_mons global_var:sr_site_spec_olympus_mons = 2 } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_hab_value_olympus_mons = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_olympus_mons } value = global_var:sr_site_hab_olympus_mons }
}
sr_site_def_value_olympus_mons = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_def_olympus_mons } value = global_var:sr_site_def_olympus_mons }
}
sr_site_port_value_olympus_mons = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_port_olympus_mons } value = global_var:sr_site_port_olympus_mons }
}
sr_site_levels_olympus_mons = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_def_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_port_value_olympus_mons
}
sr_site_extra_levels_olympus_mons = {
	value = sr_site_levels_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_hab_value_olympus_mons
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_olympus_mons = {
	value = sr_site_levels_olympus_mons
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_olympus_mons = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_olympus_mons < sr_site_crew_needed_olympus_mons
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_olympus_mons
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_olympus_mons
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_olympus_mons = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_olympus_mons
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_olympus_mons
}
sr_site_mult_b_olympus_mons = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_olympus_mons
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_olympus_mons
}
sr_site_spec_built_olympus_mons = { value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_olympus_mons add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_olympus_mons }
sr_site_generic_built_olympus_mons = {
	value = sr_site_hab_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_def_value_olympus_mons
	add = sr_site_port_value_olympus_mons
}
sr_mod_spec_used_olympus_mons = {
	value = sr_site_spec_built_olympus_mons
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_a_olympus_mons } add = var:sr_mq_a_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_a_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_b_olympus_mons } add = var:sr_mq_b_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_b_olympus_mons }
}
sr_mod_slots_used_olympus_mons = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_olympus_mons
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_hab_olympus_mons } add = var:sr_mq_hab_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_def_olympus_mons } add = var:sr_mq_def_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_port_olympus_mons } add = var:sr_mq_port_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_olympus_mons } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_olympus_mons }
}

sr_site_staffing_ganymede = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_ganymede < sr_site_crew_needed_ganymede
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_ganymede
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_ganymede
	}
}

	}

# Country scope: the module levels past the first at the colonies THIS holds, the
# upkeep's multiplier (design § 8).
